title: WebStoreCatalog - Data API
description: Represents the collection of products associated with a store. This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Possible values are: GBP— British Pound USD— U.S. Dollar The default value is USD.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort

ProductCatalogId.description: The ID of the catalog, containing products.

SalesStoreId.description: The ID of the store that the catalog is associated with. This field is unique within your org.

special_access_rules: You must have the B2B Commerce license and a CMS workspace to access product media.
associated_objects: - **WebStoreCatalogHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
